title: The Amaranthine Forest
description: A beautiful purple oasis in the harsh Nether with it's own ore, mobs, and structure to delight the explorer and provide rest for the weary.
body:
![Amaranthine Logo, Purple text with a white-ish flame overtop. Tagline that reads: "A Noctis Mod"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9298e7040a8817ff05af59fd58be2cf3bd66118.png)

A violet oasis for the weary Nether traveller. A home for the peaceful Bloom who trade in the local ores. And finally, a structure for those brave enough to conquer it and claim the powerful gear it holds for themselves. All this and more awaits in the Amaranthine Forest...
